# IDBERRY Beauty

> IDBERRY Beauty is a Lagos, Nigeria luxury skincare brand founded by Idunnunmi "IDBERRY" Esan, a Nollywood actress, filmmaker and cosmetologist. It makes skincare rituals for melanin-rich skin focused on radiance, even tone and clear-looking complexions, and delivers nationwide across Nigeria and internationally.

Key facts:
- Name origin: from the founder's hip-hop singing days, when studio crews said her voice was "sweet like berry"; "ID" is short for Idunnunmi.
- Mission: to help every woman feel confident in her skin through effective, results-driven rituals and honest guidance.
- Pillars: results you can see; rituals, not random products; made for melanin-rich skin; guidance from a cosmetologist.
- Language: IDBERRY speaks of radiance, glow, brightening and even tone. It does not promote changing a person's natural complexion.
- Services: free WhatsApp skin consultations; wholesale pricing and private-label production for entrepreneurs.
- Store URLs start with a two-letter country code that sets currency (`/ng` = Nigeria, NGN; international countries use USD).

## Collections
- [Snow White](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/snow-white): signature radiance ritual for a luminous, even complexion.
- [Half Cast](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/half-cast): golden-toned glow ritual for warm, honeyed radiance.
- [Caramel Glow](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/caramel-glow): for deep, rich tones that want to stay rich and simply glow.
- [Royal Customized](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/royal-customized): the most indulgent ritual, tailored to you.
- [Targeted Care](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/targeted-care): focused care for scars, stretch marks, spots, breakouts and dark knuckles.
- [Little Ones](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/little-ones): gentle care for kids' skin and hair.
- [Herbal](https://idberrybeauty.com/ng/collections/herbal): herbal black soap and hair care.

## For agents
- Append `.md` to any product URL (or send `Accept: text/markdown`) for a Markdown version with variant IDs, prices and stock.
- Product pages post `variant_id` and `quantity` to `/{countryCode}/cart/add`; checkout link format: `https://idberrybeauty.com/buy/{variant_id}:{quantity}`.
